review_output: {"summary":"I found two MAJOR issues and one MINOR issue. No BLOCKERs. The main problems are how admission release triggers invalidation and missing lookup indexes for the new triggers.","findings":[{"area":"Concurrency/report invalidation","severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.85,"file":"migration.sql: wp20_metric_source_changed (LiveViewerSession branch)","issue":"Every normal admission release or expiry delete raises the version's sourceRevision. This marks all reports stale, including old windows, even though history is meant to survive release.","evidence":"The AFTER DELETE trigger on LiveViewerSession updates LiveMetricVersion.sourceRevision. wp20_metric_report_invalidate then marks every report with a different inputRevision as stale.","impact":"Reports never stay ready while viewers leave. Each release also writes to the hot version row, which conflicts with FOR SHARE locks from interval inserts. Batched multi-session ingestion can deadlock.","recommended_fix":"On DELETE, return without bumping the revision. On shortened expiresAt, invalidate only reports whose windows overlap the lost lease time.","required_test":"Release 500 admissions while a ready report exists for an old window. The report should stay ready, and concurrent inserts should show no lock waits or deadlocks."},{"area":"Indexes/performance regression","severity":"MAJOR","confidence":0.8,"file":"migration.sql: LiveMetricSession, LiveMetricRegistration","issue":"No index starts with admissionSessionId or submissionId. The new triggers and the cascading foreign key look rows up by these columns alone.","evidence":"The source trigger filters on s.admissionSessionId=OLD.id and r.submissionId=OLD.id. submissionId is only the last column of a composite unique index, which these lookups can't use.","impact":"Every LiveViewerSession delete or FormSubmission update/delete, including for lives without metrics, scans an evidence table that only grows.","recommended_fix":"Add indexes on LiveMetricSession(admissionSessionId) and LiveMetricRegistration(submissionId).","required_test":"Run EXPLAIN on the trigger lookups with more than 100k evidence rows. Each should use an index scan, and release latency should not increase."},{"area":"Timestamp correctness","severity":"MINOR","confidence":0.6,"file":"migration.sql: interval/session/visitor guards, report claim/finish/create","issue":"The guards compare clock_timestamp() (timestamptz) with timestamp(3) columns that hold UTC values written by Prisma. The conversion uses the session TimeZone setting.","evidence":"Examples: NEW.\"receivedAt\" := clock_timestamp(), NEW.\"createdAt\" := clock_timestamp(), and \"leaseExpiresAt\"<=clock_timestamp(). There is no AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'.","impact":"If the database or role TimeZone is not UTC, lifetime, receipt, lease and window-end checks are shifted by the offset. Valid evidence is rejected, or expired evidence is accepted.","recommended_fix":"Use (clock_timestamp() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') everywhere, or pin TimeZone=UTC in the functions with SET timezone='UTC'.","required_test":"Repeat the forged-timestamp, lifetime and lease tests with SET TimeZone='Asia/Taipei'. The results should match the UTC run."}]}
